name: BillHarbor (Dev)
short_desc: Development receipt acquisition and authenticated delivery control plane
author: EckPhi
description: Vendor-independent receipt and bill acquisition with immutable originals, local user sign-in and installable connector plugins. Development release; starts without vendors.

form_fields.label: First-run setup token
form_fields.hint: Copy this private token into BillHarbor’s welcome screen. Create your administrator and download the encryption-key backup in the app. Existing installations keep their users and keys.
